specs.derived_from: A reserve-life / decline-curve model built from the 424B4 Summary Reserve Data, or the first 10-Q, shows net decline outside the -6% to 0% band assumed here; or a declared dividend policy sets a payout that implies a different sustainable distribution than pro forma CAFD.
specs.rationale: Untestable: the band is quantified (net decline outside -6% to 0%) but 'net decline' is an output of a reserve-life / decline-curve model, not a fact on disk; WHK's ledger locks only net_income_m and its companyfacts evidence (S-1 stage, 5 concepts) carries no decline metric. The dividend-policy leg is a disclosure event, not a measurable quantity.
